name: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
summary: Routes each token to one expert, adds a load-balancing loss and a capacity factor, and pre-trains sparse Transformers of up to a trillion parameters faster than dense T5 models.

name: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
summary: Adds sharding annotations to XLA and uses them to train a 600-billion-parameter multilingual translation Transformer with top-2 mixture-of-experts layers and per-expert capacity.

name: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer
summary: Introduces a layer of thousands of feed-forward experts with a trainable noisy top-k gate, used between LSTM layers in language and translation models of up to 137 billion parameters.

name: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
summary: Studies training instability and fine-tuning of sparse expert models, proposes the router z-loss, and trains a 269-billion-parameter sparse encoder-decoder with the compute of a 32-billion-parameter dense model.
